description: The product conformance findings and their work packages. A finding either becomes an executed work package (commit + named test + demo credit) or an accepted waiver with an owner and an expiry; scripts/check-product-rework.py is the gate. The computed WSJF score is never stored; the four inputs are.

findings.spec_clause: SPEC_V2 §12 T4 gate — one remedy per interruption
findings.claim: an injected failure yields exactly one coach card and one remedy through the seeded coach process
findings.observed: the proof calls coach.triage and coach.remedy directly; no test executes the seeded cap.kanban_coach.handle_error.v2 steps, so the process wiring (which action runs when) is unproven
findings.verifier: read the test body: it invokes coach.triage/coach.remedy over HTTP after err_card; no process run is started

findings.spec_clause: SPEC_V2 §6.2 — the executor may triage but never choose the remedy
findings.observed: the exclusion is data-only in the seeded process's allowed_actions; no negative test proves an executor calling coach.remedy is refused
findings.verifier: rg for coach.remedy in the tests: only the direct helper and the happy path call it; no executor-refusal case

findings.observed: coach.escalate is registered and exposed but no test or seeded process calls it; only the automatic repeat-signature escalation is proved
findings.verifier: rg coach.escalate across tests and seed: the action exists, no caller

findings.claim: a depth cap bounds coach recursion
findings.observed: COACH_CHAIN_MAX counts interruptions per card (breadth); nesting is prevented wholesale by the coach-card refusal, and no test asserts run nesting
findings.verifier: read the constant and its use: it bounds interruptions attached to one card, not nested coach runs

findings.spec_clause: SPEC_V2 §8.1 — the mandatory artefact set comes from the standard, filtered by the adm_profile
findings.claim: a phase cannot pass with a mandatory artefact missing
findings.observed: the gate starts satisfied when the profile names no requirements for a phase (`satisfied = sets.is_empty()`), never reads artifact_type.mandatory, and profile_tailor accepts any map: a tenant can tailor an empty profile and advance every phase vacuously
findings.verifier: read the gate: sets empty -> satisfied true; grep for artifact_type.mandatory in the gate: no use

findings.spec_clause: SPEC_V2 §8.1 Preliminary — the board adopts the profile
findings.claim: phase advance is governed by an adopted profile
findings.observed: get_profile_tx prefers an adopted row but falls back to the latest draft; adopt_with_decision_id is optional, so a draft profile governs advance
findings.verifier: read get_profile_tx: adopted preferred, otherwise latest draft is returned

findings.spec_clause: SPEC_V2 §8.1 Phase H — exactly one typed outcome
findings.claim: the H advance is satisfied by a review of the H contract
findings.observed: the check is EXISTS any compliance review for the project with a non-null outcome, so a Phase-G review's outcome satisfies H and the outcome field is optional on every review
findings.verifier: read the SQL: project_id only, no contract_id or phase filter

findings.spec_clause: SPEC_V2 §8.1 Phase H — a kata candidate
findings.claim: a kata outcome names a typed candidate
findings.observed: change outcomes validate a change_id; kata outcomes accept any free-form object with no candidate row or identity
findings.verifier: read the outcome validation branch: change is typed, kata is unvalidated

findings.spec_clause: SPEC_V2 §8.2 — a person approves the PI plan
findings.claim: a PI plan is approved before cards are materialised
findings.observed: the worker tick materialises every planned PI cadence in its own transaction and flips planned -> materialised with no approval gate; no approve/reject action or approval target exists
findings.verifier: read the tick and the cadence action list: no approve action; materialise commits without an approval id

findings.spec_clause: SPEC_V2 §8.2 — inspect and adapt produces lessons; §12 T10 — retro produces lessons
findings.claim: a retro can record its findings and close
findings.observed: record_retro_findings_tx and close_retro_tx exist only as store functions; no actions are registered, so a coach or a person cannot drive a retro through the API
findings.verifier: rg for name = "retros." or "retro." in crates/actions: none; registry lists no retro action

findings.spec_clause: SPEC_V2 §8.2 — backlog refinement re-scores WSJF and flags stale items
findings.observed: kind='refinement' is accepted at creation but the cadence tick handles only pi, demo and retro; no stale-item flag exists
findings.verifier: read the tick's kind filter: refinement is not selected

findings.spec_clause: SPEC_V2 §8.2 — PI planning materialises from the programme's standing backlog
findings.claim: a programme PI plans its cross-project backlog
findings.observed: materialisation selects backlog for one board.project_id, so a multi-project programme PI cannot plan the programme backlog; tests cover one project
findings.verifier: read materialise_pi_tx: the backlog query is scoped by board.project_id

work_packages.title: prove one remedy through the seeded coach process, not direct action calls
work_packages.definition_of_done: an end-to-end test starts the seeded cap.kanban_coach.handle_error.v2 run and asserts exactly one coach card, one remedy and (for a systemic class) one kata without manual action calls
acceptance: Given an injected failure, when the seeded coach process runs, then exactly one remedy row exists and no test code called coach.remedy directly

work_packages.title: close the coach's untested edges: agent-issued remedy refusal and coach.escalate
work_packages.definition_of_done: an executor calling coach.remedy is refused with a named error, and coach.escalate is either exercised by a test/seed process or removed with a recorded reason
acceptance: Given an agent step, when it calls coach.remedy, then the call is refused and no remedy row is written
Given an escalated interruption, when coach.escalate is invoked, then the state and approval are recorded

work_packages.title: name the coach chain cap what it measures or assert nesting
work_packages.definition_of_done: the cap's name and documentation state breadth (interruptions per card), or a test asserts the nesting it claims to bound
acceptance: Given a coach card about a coach card, when the pull guard runs, then it is refused and the test names the guard that did it

work_packages.title: a tailored ADM profile cannot empty a phase or drop the standard's mandatory artefacts
work_packages.definition_of_done: profile_tailor refuses a requirement key that is not a seeded artifact_type for that phase, refuses a phase in the phase_set with no requirement set, and refuses dropping a standard-mandatory type; the phase gate keeps its refusal and its tests
acceptance: Given a profile naming a phase with no requirement set, when it is tailored, then the action refuses
Given a profile dropping artifact_type.mandatory for a phase, when it is tailored, then the action refuses
Given a valid adopted profile, when a phase misses a named artefact, then the advance refuses 409 and writes nothing

work_packages.title: phase advance refuses a profile the board has not adopted
work_packages.definition_of_done: the advance path resolves only an adopted profile; a draft profile refuses with a named error and writes nothing
acceptance: Given only a draft profile, when a phase advance runs, then it is refused and no WBS row moves

work_packages.title: the H outcome is the H contract's review, and a kata outcome names a candidate
work_packages.definition_of_done: the H gate reads a review against the H contract (or the project's open H contract), and a kata outcome is validated against a typed candidate reference
acceptance: Given a G review with an outcome and no H review, when H advances, then it is refused
Given a kata outcome with no candidate reference, when it is recorded, then it is refused

work_packages.title: a PI plan is approved by a person before any card is materialised
work_packages.definition_of_done: the cadence states are planned -> proposed -> approved -> materialised; cadences.approve_plan/approve the plan carries an approval gate decided by someone other than the proposer; the worker materialises only approved plans and a unit test proves an unapproved plan creates no card
acceptance: Given a planned PI cadence with no approval, when the worker ticks, then no card is created and the cadence stays unapproved
Given an approved PI plan, when the worker ticks, then the cards are created once and the cadence moves to materialised
Given the proposer, when they decide their own plan approval, then the approval is refused 409

work_packages.title: retro findings and closure are actions, not store-only functions
work_packages.definition_of_done: retros.record_findings and retros.close are registered actions with refusal tests (a retro cannot close with no lesson), and the existing store tests stay green
acceptance: Given an open retro with no findings, when retros.close runs, then it is refused and the cadence stays open
Given a recorded finding, when retros.close runs, then the cadence closes and a lesson is proposed

evidence.note: actions retros.record_findings|retros.close registered (510 actions); the WBS deliverable, demo credit and Phase-G record are tranche 4 (U5d)

work_packages.title: a refinement cadence scores its backlog or is not accepted
work_packages.definition_of_done: either the tick re-scores WSJF and flags stale items for refinement cadences (with a test), or the kind is removed from the accepted set with a recorded reason
acceptance: Given a refinement cadence, when the worker ticks, then the stale backlog items are flagged once

work_packages.title: a programme PI materialises the programme backlog, not one project's
work_packages.definition_of_done: PI materialisation selects the backlog across the programme's in-flight projects in WSJF order within the WIP limit, with a two-project test
acceptance: Given two in-flight projects with backlog items, when the PI materialises, then the items are ordered by WSJF across both projects and bounded by the WIP limit
